response.sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT orders.timespan, AVG(fees.rebrate / fees.feerate) as avg_ratio, COUNT(*) as fee_count FROM fees INNER JOIN orders ON fees.orderslink = orders.recordvault GROUP BY orders.timespan), avg_count AS (SELECT AVG(fee_count) as overall_avg_count FROM grouped), filtered AS (SELECT grouped.avg_ratio, grouped.fee_count, avg_count.overall_avg_count FROM grouped CROSS JOIN avg_count WHERE grouped.fee_count > avg_count.overall_avg_count) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as avg_of_avg_ratios, SUM(fee_count) as sum_of_fee_counts, AVG(fee_count - overall_avg_count) as avg_excess_count FROM filtered

assumptions.assumption: feerate is never zero, to avoid division-by-zero errors in the expression rebrate / feerate. The schema and documentation do not explicitly prohibit zero values, but the semantics of "fee percentage" and the lack of error-handling guidance make this a safe assumption.
